paragraphs: The Discovery SDV8 was fitted to the D3 and D4 generations of the Discovery — roughly 2004 to 2016 — as the flagship diesel V8 option in the range. Early D3 cars (2004–2009) use the TDV8 designation, while later D4 cars (2009–2016) use the SDV8 badge, reflecting a higher output tune of the same 4.4-litre V8 diesel family. Both share the same fundamental architecture and the same known wear patterns as the wider TDV6/SDV6 family they're derived from. Land Rover Discovery SDV8 Engine Codes TDV8 (D3, 2004–2009) A 4.4-litre V8 diesel fitted to the Discovery D3 from 2004 to 2009. Known for timing chain tensioner wear, injector seal leaks and crankshaft bearing failure risk — a pattern shared with the wider TDV6/SDV6 family. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR components, turbo components and gaskets as standard on every TDV8 rebuild. Check Your TDV8 Discovery SDV8 → [link to quote form] SDV8 (D4, 2009–2016) The higher-output version of the 4.4-litre V8 diesel, fitted to the Discovery D4 from 2009 to 2016. Shares the same fundamental architecture and known wear pattern as the TDV8 — timing chain tensioner wear, injector seal leaks and crankshaft bearing failure risk. We service it to the same standard as the TDV8, replacing the same components as standard on every SDV8 rebuild. Check Your SDV8 Discovery SDV8 → [link to quote form] Land Rover Discovery SDV8 Engine Compatibility Because the Discovery SDV8 spans two engine codes across two generations, and because the SDV8 is a higher-output tune of the same basic engine, fitting the wrong replacement or assuming a TDV8 part will work on an SDV8 car can create compatibility issues. We also cover: [Land Rover Discovery TDV6 Engine →] · [Land Rover Discovery SDV6 Engine →] · [Land Rover Discovery D250 Engine →] · [Land Rover Discovery D300 Engine →] · [Land Rover Discovery D350 Engine →] · [Land Rover Discovery P400 Engine →] [← View All Land Rover Discovery Engines] Frequently Asked Questions What engine does the Land Rover Discovery SDV8 use? It depends on the generation. D3 cars (2004–2009) use the TDV8 4.4-litre V8 diesel, while D4 cars (2009–2016) use the SDV8 — a higher-output version of the same 4.4-litre V8 diesel. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has. How much does a Land Rover Discovery SDV8 engine rebuild cost? Rebuilds start from £4,500, for either engine code. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote. Which engine code is fitted to my Discovery SDV8? Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the TDV8 or the SDV8 before you're quoted anything. Do you rebuild TDV8 Discovery SDV8 engines? Yes. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR components, turbo components and gaskets as standard on every TDV8 rebuild. Do you rebuild SDV8 Discovery SDV8 engines? Yes. The SDV8 shares the same fundamental architecture as the TDV8 and we service it to the same standard, replacing the same components on every rebuild. Do you supply used Discovery SDV8 engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my Discovery SDV8 if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does a Discovery SDV8 engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most Discovery SDV8 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Discovery SDV8 from 2023 to present. The TDV8 or SDV8 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older TDV8 or SDV8 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every TDV8 or SDV8 rebuild.
